scripts.ollama:pull: docker exec opencanon-ollama ollama run llama3.2 "" || exit 0
scripts.build:electron: tsc electron/main.ts electron/preload.ts --outDir dist-electron --module CommonJS --esModuleInterop --ignoreConfig && echo {"type":"commonjs"} > dist-electron/package.json
scripts.electron:dev: npm run ollama:up && npm run ollama:pull && concurrently -k "vite" "npm run build:electron && wait-on tcp:5173 && electron ."
scripts.electron:build: npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron-builder
